title: Argentinian Sweet Empanadas
description: Delicious sweet empanadas filled with dulce de leche and topped with powdered sugar. A classic Argentinian dessert.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, sugar, and salt.
Add softened butter and mix until the dough comes together.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place 1-2 tsp of dulce de leche in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges to seal.
Brush the tops with egg wash and sprinkle with sugar.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
Let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
